value_stream.name: Dual Training System (DTS) & TESDA Partnership Program

fields.Participants: TVI Coordinator, TESDA Regional Inspector, Facilities Standards Manager (VS-138)
fields.Trigger: Strategic L&D plan and TVI alignment target (VS-19.4)

workflows.name: TESDA DTS Dual Training Accreditation and Site Inspection

Controls: - CTL-41: LGU/agency permit renewal alert engine; HR-L&D Manager formal sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Accreditation lapse risk**: Delayed accreditation blocks student deployment and halts tax incentives; mitigated by initiating renewals 90 days before expiry.
System Touchpoints: - HR Compliance Tracker, TESDA Document Library.
Time Estimate: - ~15-30 days for inspection and certification issuance

steps.activity: Submit DTS accreditation application to local TESDA Provincial Office.
Coordinate TESDA physical site inspection of store/DC training facilities.
Verify OHS standards, training tools, and supervisor qualifications against TESDA guidelines.
Secure DTS Certificate of Accreditation and upload to compliance library.

fields.Participants: TVI Director, VP Legal (VS-100), Chief Accountant (VS-17)

workflows.name: Technical-Vocational Institution TVI Partner Screening and SLA

Automation Opportunity: - Standardized DTS MOA template generator with automated school compliance verification checks.
Controls: - CTL-06: Prevent unauthorized vendor onboarding; board authorization limits adhered to.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal operations), VS-29 (master data)
Pain Points / Risks: - **TVI accreditation loss risk**: TVI partner loses its TESDA registry status during program cycle; mitigated by quarterly partner credential verification audits.
Time Estimate: - ~10-15 working days for negotiation and signing

steps.activity: Vet candidate TVIs (technical-vocational schools) for curriculum alignment and TESDA status.
Draft DTS Memoradum of Agreement (MOA) and SLA defining student allowances, curriculum blocks, and coordinator liaison rules.
Review legal liabilities, insurance, and tax structure with VP Legal.
Execute MOA and register TVI in vendor master system.

fields.Participants: TVI Coordinator, Category Manager (VS-01.1), Store Manager (VS-07)

workflows.name: DTS Training Plan and Curriculum Design Collaboration

Automation Opportunity: - Digital curriculum catalog portal with editable training blocks.
Controls: - CTL-779 (ensure controlled execution — DTS Accreditation & TVI Onboarding (PA-183.1).)
- operational: curriculum validation control; QA sign-off on curriculum standards.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Skills mismatch risk**: Trainee curriculum does not match store-level operational needs, reducing productivity; mitigated by Category Manager curriculum review.

steps.activity: Synchronize school technical curriculum with practical store operations blocks (60/40 mix).
Define competencies: custom paint mixing, tool mechanics, safety, customer service consultations.
Review training plan with Category Manager for technical accuracy.
Submit training curriculum to TESDA for approval.

fields.Participants: TVI Coordinator, Store Manager, HR Compliance Manager
fields.Trigger: Approved training plan (W5251) and store vacancy targets

workflows.name: Student Recruitment Interviewing and Intake Scheduling

Automation Opportunity: - ATS integration with TVI student registry database for rapid candidate data import.
Controls: - CTL-779 (ensure controlled execution — DTS Accreditation & TVI Onboarding (PA-183.1).)
- operational: Customer and personnel data privacy controls; HR Manager approval on final rosters.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Trainee screening failure risk**: Trainees with inadequate background screening placed in security-sensitive roles; mitigated by enforcing background checks before scheduling in-store.

steps.activity: Publish intake slots to TVI partner schools and request candidate lists.
Conduct mass interviews and practical aptitude checks at TVI campus.
Process background screening and medical clearances per W4865.
Schedule approved student intake batches and assign to store/DC locations.

fields.Owner: Store HR Administrator / Assistant Store Manager
fields.Participants: Student Trainee, Store Safety Officer (VS-24), Uniform Custodian (VS-169)

workflows.name: DTS Program Onboarding Safety Induction and Uniform Issuance

Automation Opportunity: - Online onboarding learning modules and automated uniform allocation tracking.
Controls: - CTL-779 (ensure controlled execution — DTS Accreditation & TVI Onboarding (PA-183.1).)
- operational: personnel data privacy controls; OHS safety certification gate.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Safety training omission risk**: Trainees deployed to sales floor without safety gear or training, risking injury; mitigated by system-gate requiring signed safety briefing before ID card release.
System Touchpoints: - Learning Management System (VS-19.4), Uniform Inventory Module (VS-169).

steps.a: Store HR Administrator / Assistant Store Manager
steps.activity: Conduct DTS program orientation and store rules briefing.

steps.a: Store HR Administrator / Assistant Store Manager
steps.activity: Execute site-safety and emergency evacuation training at store/DC.

steps.a: Store HR Administrator / Assistant Store Manager
steps.activity: Issue DTS-branded uniforms and required PPE (safety boots, glasses).

steps.a: Store HR Administrator / Assistant Store Manager
steps.activity: Conduct trainee tour and introduce to store department mentors.

workflows.name: Student-Trainee Profiling and Non-Employee Profile Provisioning

Automation Opportunity: - Automated AD security group assignment based on HRIS non-employee status tags.
Controls: - CTL-779 (ensure controlled execution — DTS Accreditation & TVI Onboarding (PA-183.1).)
- operational: Customer and personnel data privacy controls; Store Manager profile approval.
Cross-references: - links to VS-19 (Hire to Retire), VS-27 (IT operations)
Pain Points / Risks: - **System over-access risk**: Trainees gain unauthorized transaction systems access (voids, returns, credit checks); mitigated by assigning restricted "Trainee" security groups in Active Directory.
System Touchpoints: - HRIS Platform (VS-19), IAM Module (VS-27), Time & Attendance system.

steps.activity: Create non-employee student-trainee profile in HRIS.
Upload signed DTS training agreement, student ID, and school records.
Provision limited store system access (RF scanner view, learning modules).
Register trainee biometrics in time and attendance terminal.

fields.Frequency: Per active TVI partnership program cycle
fields.Participants: TVI Coordinator, Store Manager, Escalation Desk Analyst

workflows.name: TVI Coordinator Communication Portal and Escalation Matrix Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Partner portal SMS integration and automated daily attendance mismatch reporting.
Controls: - CTL-779 (ensure controlled execution — DTS Accreditation & TVI Onboarding (PA-183.1).)
- operational: data privacy controls; HR-L&D Manager sign-off on partner access directories.
Cross-references: - links to VS-03 (vendor portal), VS-27 (IT operations), VS-91 (privacy)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Absence reporting lapse risk**: Unexcused trainee absences not reported to school coordinators, compromising program records; mitigated by automated system trigger sending daily attendance mismatch logs to TVIs.

steps.activity: Create school coordinator user account on BuildRight partner portal.
Publish student assignment schedules, store locations, and mentor contact list.
Configure automated SMS alerts for coordinator notification of student absences.
Set up program escalation matrix (Store SM -> Regional HR -> HR-L&D Manager).

fields.Participants: TVI Director, Store Manager, Chief Accountant (VS-17)

workflows.name: Annual DTS Partnership Performance Audit and Contract Renewal

Automation Opportunity: - Automated scorecard data pulls from LMS and payroll systems.
Controls: - CTL-41: LGU/agency renewal tracking controls; CHRO approval required for renewals.
Pain Points / Risks: - **KPI reporting bias risk**: Inaccurate performance logs lead to renewal of underperforming schools; mitigated by cross-referencing audit metrics with automated HRIS graduation logs.
Time Estimate: - ~10-15 working days for audit and renewal

steps.activity: Compile partnership KPI scorecard: student graduation rate, retention, OHS compliance, tax savings.
Conduct contract review and audit partner TVI records.
Negotiate contract renewal adjustments (stipends, volume slots).
Execute agreement renewal and update compliance log.
